status: development; every number produced with this config is a local reference figure, not the official score
note: Two official slices of the same EasyEDA symbol pool: the released BoxICLibrary (1000 parts) and the library shipped with the public dataset (337 parts). 148 keys are shared, so both are loaded and merged by part number.
libraries: ../赛题六公开数据集/赛题六公开数据集/cpntLibrary

rules.observed_number_is_never_overwritten: the library's own numbering drifts from the reference (EasyEDA splits one package pin into 6_1/6_2, and 0099's IR4428 entry puts a pin at 9 where the reference says 6), so an override risks a false-positive pin plus a wrong net member
rules.consistency_gate: when a component has at least min_consistency_pairs pins carrying both an observed number and an observed name, the entry must reproduce at least min_consistency of them, otherwise the whole entry is declined
rules.fill_remaining_numbers: off: a guessed number costs a false-positive pin and a wrong net member, and the entry's numbering order is not the schematic's pin order

fuzzy_note: OCR truncation: HS96L03W2C0 vs the real HS96L03W2C03; only accepted when exactly one library key is within 2 characters and a read pin name is in that entry.
pattern_note: No model name: an entry is accepted only when its pin names cover every name we read AND reproduce every pin number we also read (>=2 of them).
